title: 30A Dunes | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: 30A Dunes — a house in Watersound, Florida. 8 guests · 4 bedrooms · 4 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to '30A Dunes' professionally managed by Stay on 30a. A 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home in the gated community of WaterSound that comfortably sleeps 8. This inviting retreat blends timeless coastal charm with elevated design and craftsmanship, creating a warm and elegant escape just steps from the Gulf.Inside, the home’s thoughtful design shines through in every detail, from the Venetian plaster walls to the 100-year-old repurposed wooden beams that add both texture and character. The open-concept living and dining spaces offer the perfect backdrop for gathering with family and friends, while the well-equipped kitchen makes preparing meals and entertaining a pleasure.Step outside to your own private oasis featuring a sparkling pool and a spacious screened-in porch complete with a fireplace and TV, perfect for slow mornings with coffee or cozy evenings under the glow of the fire. When you’re ready for sand and surf, the private deeded beach access is just steps away, offering effortless days along the sugar-white shoreline.Guests also enjoy access to two community pools and six adult bikes, ideal for exploring the scenic paths, trails, and neighboring coastal towns along 30A.With its refined interiors, inviting outdoor spaces, and unbeatable location, 30A Dunes offers the perfect balance of comfort, craftsmanship, and coastal relaxation.ACCOMMODATIONS30A Dunes comfortably accommodates up to 8 people:First Floor:Bedroom 1: Queen, Ensuite BathroomSecond Floor:Bedroom 2: King, Ensuite BathroomBedroom 3: Twin/Twin BunkBedroom 4: King, Ensuite BathroomHOME HIGHLIGHTSGated communityPrivate heated pool Pool heating available for an additional fee/$25Access to private beach with optional chair service (additional charge direct to vendor)WiFi6 adult bikesFully stocked kitchenFull washer & dryerPrivate screened in porchCommunity pool accessSonos sound systemIndoor & outdoor fireplaceWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed Linens |WELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGTwo parking spaces available (2 driveway). No street parking allowed. **Additional vehicles will need to be parked off Watersound premises. Location can be provided by guest services.Included is 6 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.WATERSOUND COMMUNITY HIGHLIGHTSOver 250 Acre Gated Beach Community on the Gulf of Mexico between Seaside and Rosemary Beach(2) Community PoolsParks, Walking Trails and Meandering BoardwalksBike to Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach and Rosemary BeachA short walk to The Big Chill (formerly The Hub)**Please Note:*Access to the WaterSound Beach Club is not included.*WaterSound does not allow golf cart rentals.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
